snippet.title: Inside a College Game | Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
snippet.description:
Locker room decisions, a halftime response and player growth after the final buzzer. Follow a college game in Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend, a basketball career simulation for PC. You manage your player’s career, not the club.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4968700/Hoop_Dynasty_Rise_of_a_Legend/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=evergreen_wishlist&utm_content=college_game_news

Recorded gameplay, edited to remove long waits. English interface and text. This video accompanies our Steam news and does not announce that the Playtest is open.

Official website: https://hoopdynasty.info/

#BasketballGame #IndieGame #HoopDynasty
